card.name: Dates and joined names in web text
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short pieces right after a calendar day in a web page date line, such as the comma after 'April 11'. It also fires inside joined site or brand names such as 'PhysOrg' and 'Global Voices'.

modes.label: Date line comma
modes.description: The comma or ordinal ending after a month and day, just before the year in a post or article date.

modes.label: Joined site names
modes.description: The second part of a compound website or account name, often followed by a URL or social handle.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a web date stamp, or in a website's name, where a year or a link usually comes next.
